entries.title: Proverbs 8:1
segments: ¶Does not wisdom cry out, And understanding lift up her voice?

entries.title: Proverbs 8:2
segments: She takes her stand on the top of the high hill, Beside the way, where the paths meet.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:3
segments: She cries out by the gates, at the entry of the city, At the entrance of the doors:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:4
segments: "To you, O men, I call, And my voice [is] to the sons of men.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:5
segments: O you simple ones, understand prudence, And you fools, be of an understanding heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:6
segments: Listen, for I will speak of excellent things, And from the opening of my lips [will come] right things;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:7
segments: For my mouth will speak truth; Wickedness [is] an abomination to my lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:8
segments: All the words of my mouth [are] with righteousness; Nothing crooked or perverse [is] in them.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:9
segments: They [are] all plain to him who understands, And right to those who find knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:10
segments: Receive my instruction, and not silver, And knowledge rather than choice gold;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:11
segments: For wisdom [is] better than rubies, And all the things one may desire cannot be compared with her.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:12
segments: ¶"I, wisdom, dwell with prudence, And find out knowledge [and] discretion.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:13
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] to hate evil; Pride and arrogance and the evil way And the perverse mouth I hate.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:14
segments: Counsel [is] mine, and sound wisdom; I [am] understanding, I have strength.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:15
segments: By me kings reign, And rulers decree justice.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:16
segments: By me princes rule, and nobles, All the judges of the earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:17
segments: I love those who love me, And those who seek me diligently will find me.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:18
segments: Riches and honor [are] with me, Enduring riches and righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:19
segments: My fruit [is] better than gold, yes, than fine gold, And my revenue than choice silver.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:20
segments: I traverse the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice,

entries.title: Proverbs 8:21
segments: That I may cause those who love me to inherit wealth, That I may fill their treasuries.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:22
segments: ¶"The LORD possessed me at the beginning of His way, Before His works of old.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:23
segments: I have been established from everlasting, From the beginning, before there was ever an earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:24
segments: When [there were] no depths I was brought forth, When [there were] no fountains abounding with water.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:25
segments: Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills, I was brought forth;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:26
segments: While as yet He had not made the earth or the fields, Or the primeval dust of the world.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:27
segments: When He prepared the heavens, I [was] there, When He drew a circle on the face of the deep,

entries.title: Proverbs 8:28
segments: When He established the clouds above, When He strengthened the fountains of the deep,

entries.title: Proverbs 8:29
segments: When He assigned to the sea its limit, So that the waters would not transgress His command, When He marked out the foundations of the earth,

entries.title: Proverbs 8:30
segments: Then I was beside Him [as] a master craftsman; And I was daily [His] delight, Rejoicing always before Him,

entries.title: Proverbs 8:31
segments: Rejoicing in His inhabited world, And my delight [was] with the sons of men.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:32
segments: ¶"Now therefore, listen to me, [my] children, For blessed [are those who] keep my ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:33
segments: Hear instruction and be wise, And do not disdain [it].

entries.title: Proverbs 8:34
segments: Blessed is the man who listens to me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:35
segments: For whoever finds me finds life, And obtains favor from the LORD;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:36
segments: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul; All those who hate me love death."
